summary: Tested new Customer Support / Tickets module (backend + frontend). Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass covering dashboard KPIs, list+filters (status/priority/mine/q + derived overdue), CRUD ticket lifecycle (create, status open->in_progress->closed with closed_date, comment updates, attachments add/delete), CRM customers list+stats+create, config get/update (11 default types, 4 priorities, channels), staff list, reports (avg_completion_hours, employee, top_customers, most_complaints), notifications list + read-all, and role gating (staff arun@vetmech.com reaches /api/tickets*, unauth => 401). Verified overdue is derived only (PATCH status=overdue rejected with 400). Frontend: after fixing critical auth-token bug in api.js the whole /admin/support/* module renders correctly - Support Dashboard shows 23 total / 1 open / 1 in-progress / 2 pending / 11 overdue / 8 completed KPI cards, Ticket Overview line chart, Tickets by Type + Priority donuts, Recent + Overdue panels; Tickets page lists 23 rows with colored status/priority badges, row click opens ticket-detail-sheet, set-status-in_progress works and updates timeline; Customers list shows 8 seeded customers; Create Ticket flow selects Radix customer/type/assignee, submits (POST /api/tickets => 200) and redirects to /admin/support/tickets; Calendar month grid renders tickets on due dates; Reports page shows employee performance table + CSV/Excel/PDF buttons; Settings shows 11 types + 4 priorities + 4 channel toggles; Notification bell popover opens.

ui_bugs.issue: Console a11y warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen readers (wrap in VisuallyHidden if hidden visually). Not blocking, but should be fixed for accessibility.

action_items: Review the api.js interceptor fix (added /tickets and /crm/ to isAdmin path check) - see rca. The main agent may want a more robust approach (e.g. explicit list of admin paths or module-based token routing) but the current fix is minimal and unblocks the whole support module.
Add a DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if not desired visually) inside TicketDetailSheet to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL (fixed): /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js interceptor gated the admin bearer token on url.includes('/admin') or '/auth/admin' only. All new tickets endpoints (/api/tickets*, /api/crm/customers*) fell through to the customer token branch => 401 across the entire support module. Fixed by extending isAdmin to also include '/tickets' and '/crm/'.

backend/routers/tickets.py: /tickets/{tid} GET is declared before /tickets/notifications/list; since 'notifications/list' contains a slash, path-param matching is safe. However /tickets/{tid} could still swallow future GET /tickets/<single-word-collection> so keep specific routes above the {tid} route (dashboard, reports, config, staff already correctly placed above).
Overdue is correctly derived in decorate() and non-persisted; PATCH status=overdue returns 400 as required.
notify() targets assignee only, so a super-admin creator does not receive their own creation notification in /notifications/list unless assigned to self - by design.
config PUT uses upsert and strips _id; safe.
Attachment DELETE does not add an activity entry (add/upload does). Minor - consider adding for audit parity.

rca of the issue: Frontend 401 across support module: axios request interceptor at /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js chose the token based on url.includes('/admin') or '/auth/admin'. New tickets endpoints (/api/tickets, /api/crm/customers) hit neither substring, so it fell through to localStorage.getItem('vm_customer_token') which is null for an admin session -> no Authorization header sent -> require_module('tickets') dependency returned 401. Reproduced by logging in as admin then navigating to /admin/support; DevTools showed 401s. Mitigation applied: extended isAdmin to also include '/tickets' and '/crm/' so admin token is attached. Verified: dashboard, list, create, status change, calendar, reports, settings all render with data.
